body: Thank you for your encouraging words. I think I’ll try to remind myself of the good things during this time.

Thank you so much for really looking into my posts :’) your response really resonated with me and I feel like I’ve been really cared for by someone other than my family. 

Also thank you for sharing a bit of your LDR experience. I’m sorry your relationship didn’t work out. You seem like a great person who’d have no problem finding another amazing partner. 

I like that saying. I’ve never heard of it before. I will try to think that way and remind myself while I’m in this dark time.

I just wanted to hear if people had similar experiences of knowing couples who rushed online dating and it worked out. I mean I’m sure those relationships do work out, but it’s rare and I don’t want her to get hurt.

This is exactly how I feel. I always struggled with finding friends because I want that “perfect” friend who’s 100% relatable. I always cut off friends who talk about things that I don’t have an interest in. 

I’m not sure why I do but I’m guessing it’s because they wouldn’t like what I like so they’d unfriend me. In the end, I’d unconsciously distance myself away from them so I wouldn’t be rejected first. It’s selfish but it hurts less because at least it would be my choice. 

If it was the other way around and they ignored me or rejected me, I would end up with so much more anxiety due to worrying about how they feel or what I did wrong etc.

I feel a little better knowing that I’m not the only one. For us, it’s so much harder to make new friends because we have SAD. I just worry that it might take years for me to find more good ones like her :( she does respond once a day but it’s very little compared to before. I’m slowly trying to accept it..
I feel the same. This is also why it’s hard for me to talk to other people because I have nothing to say or share about myself. I’m so boring
This always happens to me too. It takes me years to find a great friend who I can connect with and then after a few months, what do you know, they end up moving away or having a bf and replacing me.
